item.title: Greek City Times Exclusive: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis' Historic Visit to Australia Set for March 25
item.description: Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis will visit Sydney, Canberra, and Melbourne on March 25, 2026, for Greek Independence Day. Annual celebrations will feature 50 Greek flags flying and 20 buildings illuminated in blue and white, with a special request for Parliament House in Canberra to light up in Greek colors. item.title: Shocking Theft in Patras: Roma Youths Rob Children of New Year's Carol Money – CCTV Footage Released
item.description: In Patras, three young Roma men forcibly stole money earned by two children singing New Year's kalanta, captured on CCTV. Police are hunting the suspects after the disturbing robbery on Kanellopoulou Street. item.title: Ancient Industrial Complex and Roman Necropolis Discovered in Egypt's Western Nile Delta
item.description: Archaeologists have unearthed an extensive industrial complex from the Late Period and early Ptolemaic era, along with a Roman-period necropolis, in Egypt's western Nile Delta. Discoveries include evidence of large-scale salted fish production, diverse workshops, varied burial practices, and artifacts like gold earrings. item.title: Tragic Death of Tommy Lee Jones' Daughter Victoria at San Francisco Hotel on New Year's Day
item.description: Victoria Kafka Jones, the 34-year-old daughter of Oscar-winning actor Tommy Lee Jones, was found dead early on January 1, 2026, at the Fairmont San Francisco hotel. Emergency services pronounced her deceased at the scene after responding to a medical emergency; no foul play is suspected, and the cause remains under investigation.
